entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: List has been revised.

2. Heard Sri Siddharth Singh, learned Amicus Curiae for the applicants and Sri Sunil Singh, learned A.G.A. for the State as well as perused the record.
3.

The present anticipatory bail application has been filed on behalf of the applicants in Case Crime No.345 of 2018 registered under Sections 498A, 323, 504, 313, 376 and 506 IPC at Police Station- Badlapur, District Jaunpur with a prayer to enlarge them on anticipatory bail.

4. The instant anticipatory bail application qua applicant nos.1 and 4 was rejected by this Court vide order dated 17.6.2021 and applicant nos.2 and 3 were granted anticipatory bail by the same order.

entities.text: Sudheer Nishad And 3 Others vs State Of U.P.And Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Therefore, the instant anticipatory bail application is being heard qua applicant nos.2 and 3 only.
5. Learned Amicus Curiae for the applicants has stated that the applicants have been falsely implicated in the present case.
They are the parents of the husband of the informant and have nothing to do with the said offence as they live separately to the husband.
Learned Amicus Curiae has further stated that the applicants are aged persons.
Several other submissions have been made on behalf of the applicants to demonstrate the falsity of the allegations made against them.
The circumstances which, as per counsel, led to the false implication of the applicants have also been touched upon at length.
The applicants have apprehension of their arrest.

LearnedAmicus Curiae for the applicants undertakes that they have co-operated in the investigation and are ready to do so in trial also failing which the State can move appropriate application for cancellation of anticipatory bail.
6. Per contra, learned A.G.A. has vehemently opposed the anticipatory bail application.

7. On due consideration to the arguments advanced by learnedAmicus Curiae for the applicants as well as learned A.G.A. and considering the nature of accusations and antecedents of the applicants,
the applicants are liable to be enlarged on anticipatory bail in view of the judgment of Supreme Court in the case of "Sushila Aggarwal Vs. State (NCT of Delhi), (2020) 5 SCC 1".

entities.text: Sushila Aggarwal Vs. State (NCT of Delhi), (2020) 5 SCC 1
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The future contingencies regarding the anticipatory bail being granted to applicants shall also be taken care of as per the aforesaid judgment of the Apex Court.
8. In view of the above, the anticipatory bail application of the applicants is allowed.

entities.text: Sudheer Nishad And 3 Others vs State Of U.P.And Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 9. It is made clear that observations made hereinabove are exclusively for deciding the instant anticipatory bail application and shall not affect the trial.

10. The Registrar General of this Court is directed to pay an honorarium of Rs.8,000/- to Sri Siddharth Singh, learned Amicus Curiae for the applicants, for having rendered effective assistance in the matter.
